productOverrides.layoutRule: tree_canvas consumes the excluded regions vertical space while bottom_action_bar keeps its original bottom position
productOverrides.treeViewportPolicy: all class, specialization and hero trees preserve the backend row/column lattice: nodes that share a source column remain vertically aligned, sparse rows retain their empty-lane branch spans, and repeated source positions fan into safe non-overlapping sockets; dense class and specialization trees use a 60px minimum row rhythm and retain their horizontal fit while the internal ScrollView owns any extra vertical reach rather than shrinking the tree back down; sparse hero trees use the same shared-lattice rule while expanding their practical width and row gap into the viewport; all graph inline coordinates use the same 750/390 rpx design unit as the canvas; the tree ScrollView adds 24px of top and bottom reach for nodes and rank labels while the page surface remains fixed
productOverrides.targetObservationPolicy: target-inventory.json and target-geometry.json remain unchanged records of the original target image
